''Mumble'' is a program frequently used for voice communication in Lojbanistan. It is free software that runs on Android, Windows, OS X, Linux and provides encryption and good sound quality. To get started, install the Mumble client and connect to a server listed below.
=Download links=
*[http://mumble.sf.net/ Desktop versions]
*[https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.morlunk.mumbleclient.free Android version]

==Rules==
It is a good idea to announce your presence on Mumble to the community, e.g. on [[Lojban IRC]] or other [[Lojbanic Forums]], either in advance or when you're ready to start chatting. In fact, some lessons can be given by means of Mumble, inquire in #ckule to get in on them.

==Recording bot==
Whenever two or more people are unmuted, a bot records all activity in the lojban room on the Metal Bunker server. The recordings can be [http://zbaga.ax.lt/mumble/ listened to here]. To talk without being recorded, you can create your own room, or if moving everyone is impractical, you can send "vreji: ko na jundi" to stop it from recording and "vreji: ko zmiku" to have it resume.
